extracted.name: Butter Chocolate Chip Cookie
extracted.description: Please try this and send me snaps below! 😁
instruction_lines: Whisk all ingredients except for the chocolate chips until mixed together.
Add the chocolate chips and whisk again until well combined
Scoop the cookie dough mixture and place on to non-stick cookie pan or pan with parchment paper
Using a fork, push down the cookie for a little bit then bake
Bake to the pre-heated oven using up and bottom heat, 190 'c for 15 minutes.
